incidentsSub: The incident log of the licence agreement (Annex 1): level, cause, fault, response and resolution times — one record for Swich and the licensee.
incidentsSubPark: Problems that affect your park's cashouts, and what PayTaxi support is doing about them.
incReportSubLicensee: Describe what drivers experience. Swich sets the final level, the cause and whose fault it is; the response clock starts the moment you send this.
incReportSubOwner: Logs the incident where the licensee can see it. The response clock starts when it is saved — acknowledge now if you are already on it.
incFieldTitlePh: e.g. Cashouts fail for every Batumi driver
incFieldStartedHint: Tbilisi time. Leave empty if it started just now.
incFieldDescriptionPh: Since when, which drivers or banks, what they see on screen…
incFieldAckNow: Acknowledge now — we are already working on it
incLevelP1Hint: Business stopped: cashouts fail for all or most drivers and there is no workaround. Response within 4 h (12 h at night), fixed within 24 h.
incLevelP2Hint: Degraded: cashing out still works or there is a workaround. Response within 8 business hours, fixed within 3 business days.
incLevelP3Hint: Minor: visual or non-critical. Response by the next business day, fixed in the next release.
incEmpty: No incidents logged. Anything that stops or slows cashouts belongs here.
incClockStartsOnRestore: The clock starts once the external service is back (Annex 1 §3.2).
incClockNoTarget: No fixed deadline — the next scheduled release.
incTxtAcknowledgedOnReport: Acknowledged when reported — work has started.
incTxtAutoQueueOpened: Opened automatically as {level}: {payouts} payout(s) of {drivers} driver(s) waiting in the queue, the oldest for more than {minutes} min; {paid} other driver(s) paid meanwhile.
incTxtAutoFault: Fault set to “{fault}” from the failure code {code}.
incTxtAutoEscalated: Level {from} → {to} automatically: payouts of {drivers} driver(s) are waiting ({payouts} payouts), {paid} other driver(s) were paid meanwhile.
incTxtAutoQueueResolved: Resolved automatically: no payouts are waiting in this park's queue any more.
incTxtAutoWideOpened: Opened automatically as P1: {payouts} payout(s) of {drivers} driver(s) at {parks} parks have waited more than {minutes} min for the same cause ({code}, {bank}).
incTxtAutoWideUpgraded: Now one incident for all parks: {payouts} payout(s) of {drivers} driver(s) at {parks} parks have waited more than {minutes} min for the same cause ({code}, {bank}).
incTxtAutoMerged: {incident} ({park}) is closed as a duplicate of this incident: the same cause holds its payouts.
incTxtAutoDuplicate: Closed as a duplicate of {of} (all parks): the same cause holds payouts at several parks. Follow {of}.
incTxtAutoWideResolved: Resolved automatically: no payout waits for this cause at any park any more.
incTxtAutoYandexOpened: Opened automatically: {failures} failed Yandex Fleet calls and none succeeded in {minutes} min.
incTxtAutoYandexOpenedParks: Opened automatically: {failures} failed Yandex Fleet calls for {parks} parks and none of theirs succeeded in {minutes} min.
incTxtAutoYandexRefused: Cashout requests are refused meanwhile: nothing is debited and nothing is queued.
incTxtAutoYandexResolved: Resolved automatically: Yandex Fleet calls succeed again.
incConfirmAck: Acknowledge it? This is the contractual response: the incident is confirmed, work has started, and the licensee sees it in this log.
incConfirmRestored: Mark the external service as back? The resolution clock starts now.
incConfirmResolve: Mark it resolved? Drivers must be able to cash out again.
incConfirmReopen: Reopen it? Give the reason — its deadlines keep counting from where they started (the report, or when it reached its level).
incRescopeHint: Moving it shows it to other parks' managers. Give it a new title and new details that do not name {park}: they read it from the move on — never what was written before, and never the cause.
incMetricMissed: Owner-fault P1 not resolved within target
incMetricUndetermined: {n} P1 with the fault not yet determined
incMetricOutside: {n} P1 at parks Swich connects directly — outside the agreement, not counted
incMetricHoursSub: From impact to resolution, counted within the month.
incMetricAbandon: P1 without a response for over {h} h
incMetricAbandonNone: No P1 waited that long for a response.
incMetricAbandonSome: Condition (a) occurred — §6 still requires written notice and time to cure.
incTrialNotSetHint: The two-week trial is tracked once the launch date is recorded.
incTrialReleased: An owner-fault P1 missed its target: the licensee owes nothing if it withdraws.
incTrialNotReleased: No owner-fault P1 has missed its target in the trial.
incTrialUndetermined: {n} P1 with the fault not determined missed its target. If it was the owner's fault, the licensee owes nothing if it withdraws — Swich has to establish the fault.
incTrialUndeterminedOpen: {n} P1 with the fault not determined still open
incContractNote: A P1 counts in the month it became a P1 — at its report, or later when a P2 was raised — and its P1 clocks and the abandonment count run from that moment (a response given before still counts); P2 and P3 count in the month they were reported. §5 counts the owner's fault only (“fault not determined” is shown apart); §6(a) counts every P1 whatever the fault, because the owner must respond to external incidents too (§3.1). Incidents of parks Swich connected directly are outside the agreement and are not counted. §6(b) — no support for {days} consecutive days — cannot be read from this log, and abandonment also needs the licensee's written notice and {cure} days to cure: the card shows only that condition (a) occurred.
incErrMetrics: Could not load the contract figures.
incErrLoad: Could not load the incident log.
incErrStartedFuture: The start cannot be in the future or after the report.
incErrStartedTooEarly: The impact can start at most {h} h before the report. If it began earlier, say so in the details — Swich can set an earlier start.
incErrRestoreTime: That time is before the impact began or in the future.
incErrNeutralText: Moving it to other parks needs a new title and new details that do not name {park}.
incErrStale: This incident changed in the meantime — showing the latest.
alertIncidentP1Many: {n} open incidents, one of them critical (P1): cashouts are failing.
alertAdviceIncidentSwichAck: Not acknowledged yet — the response clock is running.
alertAdviceIncidentSwichWorking: Acknowledged — keep the licensee informed until it is resolved.
alertAdviceIncidentOpWorking: Swich has responded and is working on it.
alertAdviceIncidentParkWorking: PayTaxi support is working on it.
loginSub: Manage cashouts, drivers and reconciliation for your taxipark — 24/7.
loginGreetSub: Enter your park credentials to continue.
sessionExpired: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.
errLicenseeNotInForce: This operator account is switched off: your company's licence agreement is not in force. Contact Swich.
overviewSub: Real-time view of payout accounts, queue and driver activity.
parkManagesFloat: Add API credentials to read the live balance
noFailedCashouts: No failed cashouts. Everything is moving.
activityFeedSub: Live stream of cashout and onboarding events.
cashoutsSub: Live queue of queued, processing, completed and failed payouts.
adjustFilters: Adjust the status, date range or search term to see results.
mcSearchHint: Search by driver name, car plate or Yandex profile ID. Only active drivers are shown.
mcWarn: Manager-initiated cashouts are logged in the audit trail and posted to Yandex on the driver's behalf.
driversSub: All drivers linked to this park, with their Yandex balances and recent activity.
searchDriversPlaceholder: Search by name, phone or plate…
noDriverAccounts: No payout account yet — the driver adds his own in the app, or you can add one here.
holderNameAdminHint: As on the holder's ID. Normally the driver's own name; a different name makes this a third-party account.
thirdPartyReasonLabel: Reason for paying a third party
thirdPartyReasonPlaceholder: e.g. driver has no bank account; wife's account; signed statement on file
thirdPartyReasonHint: Required when the holder is not the driver. Recorded in the audit log and shown on this account everywhere.
thirdPartyWarning: The holder name does not match the driver's registered name ({name}). The bank pays the IBAN regardless of the name — make sure the park has the driver's signed request on file, then give the reason below.
errThirdPartyReasonRequired: A reason is required when the account is not in the driver's name.
errInvalidIban: That is not a valid Georgian IBAN.
errBankNotSupportedAdmin: The park has no payout account at that bank.
errIbanExistsAdmin: This IBAN is already added for this driver.
errReasonTooLong: The reason is too long (max 500 characters).
errHolderTooLong: The account holder name is too long (max 200 characters).
ownAccountRuleAdmin: Drivers can only add accounts in their own name from the app. Other people's accounts must be added here, with a reason.
driverNameHint: Exactly as on the driver's ID or passport, in that script. Payouts are only allowed to an account in this name.
onboardingSub: Link a new phone number to a Yandex driver profile and issue PayTaxi access.
obVerifyDesc: Enter the driver's phone and Yandex profile ID. We'll pull their record before creating the PayTaxi account.
obYandexIdHelp: Found in fleet.yandex.com → Drivers → Driver detail → API ID
obNotFoundDesc: Verify the profile ID — it must match an active driver in this park's Yandex Fleet account.
obAlreadyDescA: is already linked to a PayTaxi account in
obConfirmDesc: We found the driver. Review the details below and create the PayTaxi account.
obCheck1Desc: The taxi park must already have this driver under their Yandex Fleet account.
obCheck2Title: You have the Yandex profile ID
obCheck3Desc: The driver will receive an OTP code to verify their phone.
obEligible: Driver is active in Yandex Fleet and eligible for instant cashout.
obNext1Desc: Driver record added to the park, linked to Yandex.
obNext2Desc: They sign in to PayTaxi with their phone number and a one-time code.
obNext3Desc: Once they add their IBAN in the app, they can withdraw 24/7.
reconciliationSub: Nightly cross-check between PayTaxi ledger, bank, and Yandex Fleet. Drifts surface here for manual resolution.
noRunsWaiting: No runs yet — waiting for the worker's first tick.
resolvePlaceholder: What did you find? What action did you take?
noOpenDiscrepancies: No open discrepancies. Ledger matches bank and Yandex.
reportsSub: Cashouts, fees and driver activity for the selected window.
noCompletedCashoutsWindow: No completed cashouts in this window.
noBankActivityWindow: No bank activity in this window.
obErrPhoneLinked: This phone is already linked to a driver.
obErrYandexLinked: This Yandex profile is already linked to a driver in this park.
drvErrPhoneDup: That phone is already linked to another driver.
drvErrYandexDup: That Yandex profile is already in use in this park.
settingsSub: Your account and taxi park details.
settingsContactNote: These details appear on cashout invoices. Keep them up to date.
settingsProfileNote: Your name and email are used to sign in and are recorded in the audit log against every manual cashout, retry and settings change you make. They never appear on invoices.
parkErrInvalidTaxId: Identification code must be 9 digits (a company) or 11 (an individual entrepreneur).
legalEntityHint: As registered with the Revenue Service, in Georgian (e.g. შპს თბილისი თაქსი სერვისი). This exact name is printed on cashout invoices.
legalDetailsWhy: Required for an active park: drivers see the legal name, identification code and phone in their privacy notice (Profile → Your park), which names the park as responsible for their data.
parkErrLegalDetailsRequired: An active park needs its legal name, identification code and phone: {fields}.
setLegalMissing: Missing: {fields}. Drivers see these in their privacy notice (Profile → Your park), so an active park needs all three — complete them under “Edit park details”. Until then an active park’s changes are not saved and a suspended park cannot be reactivated.
yandexFleetHint: From fleet.yandex.com → Settings → API. Connects the park to its drivers and balances.
apiKeyReplaceHint: Leave blank to keep the current key
addParkSub: Create a park and its first manager login. Yandex credentials connect it to the fleet.
slugHint: Used for {slug}.paytaxi.ge — leave blank to derive from the name.
managerLoginHint: The park manager signs in with these. Password min 8 characters. Name is optional.
parkCreatedDesc: is ready. Yandex is connected — sync the driver roster from Onboarding to go live.
modelAOpt: Model A — park pays from its own account
errSlugTaken: That subdomain slug is already taken.
errEmailTaken: That manager email is already in use.
errWeakPassword: Password must be at least 8 characters.
apSettlementHint: Every park the licensee connects is settled under its licence agreement, monthly, together with its other parks (§2.2). Swich-direct is a park Swich connected itself: outside the agreement, with its own split. The licensee in force is preselected.
apSettlementLoadFailed: The licensees could not be loaded — the park joins the licensee in force, if there is exactly one.
errLicenseeRequired: Several licensees are in force — choose which agreement settles this park.
errLicenseeNotFound: That licensee no longer exists — reload the page.
syncSub: Pull the park's driver roster from Yandex and onboard them in bulk.
rosterEmpty: No drivers returned by Yandex for this park. Check the park's Yandex credentials.
queuedPayoutsSub: Yandex balance already debited — the bank transfer is being retried.
noQueued: No payouts waiting on the bank.
noPayoutAccounts: No payout account yet — add one in Settings.
obIbanHint: Optional — the driver can add it in the app later. Must be at a bank the park pays out from.
obErrBankNotSupported: The park has no payout account at that bank.
feesHint: Charged per cashout, shown to the driver before confirming. The fee stays in the park account; Swich’s share is settled monthly.
errFee: Fee must be between 0 and 50 GEL.
errMinCashout: Minimum cashout must be above the fee.
errMaxCashout: Maximum must be at least the minimum.
errDailyLimit: Daily limit must be at least the minimum cashout.
bankAccountsHint: Accounts the park pays drivers from. A payout is routed to the account at the driver’s bank, so TBC→TBC stays free and instant.
credentialsHint: Client id / secret / certificate reference from the park’s business internet bank. Write-only — never shown again.
errCertificatePathNotAllowed: A certificate file path is not accepted here. Put the certificate itself in the credentials as certificatePfxBase64.
errCertificateTooLarge: That certificate is too large to be a client certificate (at most 64 KB).
initialAccountHint: Becomes the park’s primary payout account. The bank is read from the IBAN (…TB… = TBC).
settlementsSub: Monthly settlement under the licence agreement: Swich’s due amount for the month, collected from each park’s account in proportion to its fees. Never a partial take.
noSettlements: No settlements yet. Each month is settled on the 3rd of the following month.
nothingToSettle: Nothing to settle for this month.
monthlyInvoicesSub: One PDF per month from Swich to the park: the park’s monthly settlement, what was transferred and what is still outstanding. Paperwork follows money — nothing extra to pay.
stlPreviewRunning: The month is still running — these are the figures so far. It is settled automatically on day {day} of next month.
stlPreviewClosed: Not settled yet — it runs automatically on day {day} of the following month; Swich can settle it now.
stlBlocked_launch_date_not_set: No launch date yet — settlement under the agreement has not started. Fees keep accumulating and go into the first statement.
stlBlocked_before_launch: This month is before the launch date — nothing is settled for it.
stlBlocked_later_statement_exists: A later month is already settled — this month’s fees and costs were included there.
stlBlocked_month_not_closed: The month has not ended yet.
stlBlocked_park_has_licensee: This park is settled as part of its licensee’s statement.
stlBlocked_concurrent_change: The month’s fees or costs kept changing while the settlement was being written — nothing was saved. Try again in a moment.
stlCreditNote: Costs exceeded income: nothing is collected, and {amount} is credited to the licensee next month.
stlOwedNote: There was no fee income to split it by: {amount} is carried to next month as owed to Swich.
stlBarrierStaysFilled: Barrier already filled (§2.3) — a loss month does not re-open it
stlBarrierNote: Counts what Swich was entitled to in earlier statements since the launch date, then this month.
stlParksSub: Each park pays in proportion to its fees (§2.5).
stlNoParkFees: No park earned fees in this month.
stlOverdue: {days} days overdue · penalty {amount} (0.1% a day, for information)
stlOverdueTechnical: No penalty for {days} of these days: a technical fault, or nothing attempted yet (§4.1.2).
stlConfirmSettleMonth: Settle {ref} now? Each park’s share is transferred from its account in proportion to its fees. This cannot be undone.
stlSettledWithFailures: {ref}: {done} of {total} transfers completed — {failed} failed and are retried every night.
stlConfirmSettleDirect: {park}: settle {ref} now? {amount} is transferred from the park’s account to Swich. This cannot be undone.
stlExtIntro: §2.5: when a park’s account cannot cover its part, the licensee pays Swich directly — or the park pays by hand. Record that payment here: the transfer is closed for good and never collected from the park’s account again. The full amount only.
stlExtRecorded: {ref}: {amount} recorded as paid outside the platform — it is not collected from the park’s account.
stlExtErr_amount_mismatch: Only the transfer’s full amount, {amount}, can be recorded.
stlExtErr_invalid_paid_on: The date must lie between the settled month and today.
stlExtErr_not_failed: Only a failed transfer can be recorded as paid outside the platform — reload the page.
stlExtErr_transfer_at_bank: The park’s bank still holds this transfer and may yet execute it — retry it instead.
stlExtErr_bank_lookup_failed: The park’s bank could not be asked about this transfer — try again.
stlExtErr_note_too_long: The note is too long — 500 characters at most.
stlExtErr_settlement_not_found: This transfer no longer exists — reload the page.
stlExtErr_concurrent_change: The transfer changed while the payment was being recorded (a transfer attempt ran, or it was recorded meanwhile) — nothing was recorded. Reload the page and check the transfer again.
stlCostsSub: Third-party invoices for bank services, SMS, a payment provider, driver-support communication, hosting and domain (§2.4). Each side enters, corrects and deletes only the invoices it paid; an invoice counts 48 hours after it is entered, and the other side can hold one it disputes. Once a statement includes them they are locked.
stlNoCosts: No shared costs for this month.
stlAddCostSwichHint: Invoices addressed to Swich — recorded as paid by Swich.
stlAddCostLicenseeHint: Invoices addressed to the licensee — recorded as paid by the licensee.
stlCostErr_invoice_date_in_future: The invoice date cannot be in the future.
stlCostErr_amount_precision: Amounts are in tetri — at most two decimals.
stlCostErr_cost_included: Already included in a statement — it can no longer change.
stlLateCosts: Entered after this month was settled — they go into the next statement.
stlNotCountedYet: Not counted yet — on hold, or still within the review window after entry.
stlCostCutoffHint: It counts in a statement {hours} hours after you enter it — time for the other side to check it and, if it disputes it, put it on hold.
stlCostMissesRun: Entered less than {hours} h before the run on {date} — goes into the following statement
stlHeldTitle: {n} on hold — not counted until released
stlHeldSub: The other side disputes these invoices. No statement counts them until the side that held them releases them, or their owner deletes them.
stlCostDeleteTitle: Delete this invoice? It stays listed, struck through, with your reason.
stlCostHoldTitle: Put this invoice on hold? No statement counts it until you release it.
stlCostReleaseTitle: Release the hold? The next statement counts the invoice.
stlCorrectTitle: This invoice is already settled: record the difference, and the next statement counts it.
stlCorrectAmountHint: Negative lowers it (e.g. −166.50), positive adds to it.
stlCostErr_reason_required: Give a reason — the other side sees it.
stlCostErr_reason_too_long: The reason is too long (500 characters at most).
stlCostErr_invalid_amount_signed: Enter an amount other than zero.
stlCostErr_cost_not_held: It is no longer on hold.
stlCostErr_cost_not_included: Not settled yet — edit or delete it instead.
stlCostErr_correction_below_zero: With its corrections, the invoice cannot go below zero.
stlCostErr_correction_fields_fixed: A correction keeps its invoice’s details.
stlLicenseeSub: Licence agreement: every park the licensee connects is settled together, once a month.
stlLicLaunchHint: The first day the platform was available to drivers, as confirmed by e-mail. It is set or moved only before it passes, with a reason.
stlLicErr_launch_after_first_statement: The launch date cannot move past the first settled month ({ref}).
stlLicErr_invalid_share: The share must be between 0 and 100%.
stlLicErrGeneric: Could not save — check the fields.
stlLicErr_launch_date_locked: The launch date has passed — it is locked and can no longer move.
stlLicErr_launch_date_in_past: Choose today or a later day — a launch date is set before it passes.
stlLicErr_launch_reason_required: Give a reason for changing the launch date.
stlLicErr_reason_too_long: The reason is too long (500 characters at most).
stlLicLaunchLockedHint: The launch date has passed, so it is locked: the trial and the barrier count from it.
stlLicReasonHint: Goes into the change history, which the licensee sees too.
stlHistSub: Every change to what the monthly statement is computed from: the launch date, the terms and each shared-cost invoice. The same record for Swich and the licensee — it cannot be edited or deleted.
stlHistErrLoad: Could not load the change history.
stlNoLicensee: No licensee is registered — every park is settled as a Swich-direct park.
stlDirectSub: Outside the licence agreement: each park pays its own share of its fees, monthly.
stlNoDirect: No Swich-direct park has fees in this month.
stlParkViewSub: Your park’s monthly settlements: what was transferred to Swich, and the invoice for each month.
setViaLicenseeHint: Settled monthly together with the licensee’s other parks; the split follows the agreement.
setAssignUnsettled: Fees already earned stay under the arrangement in force when they were earned ({amount} of them not settled yet); new cashouts follow the new assignment.
noMonthlyInvoices: No monthly invoice yet — the first appears once the park’s first month is settled.
errOpenInvoice: Could not open the invoice. Try again.
revenueSplitHint: Swich-direct parks only: the percentage of every cashout fee settled to Swich each month. Phase 1 applies until the park’s cumulative fees reach the cap.
errLoadRoster: Could not load the Yandex roster.
errResolve: Could not mark the discrepancy as resolved.
errReportWindowTooLarge: A report can cover at most a year. Choose a shorter period.
alertSettlementFailedOne: The monthly settlement to Swich failed ({amount}).
alertSettlementFailedMany: {n} settlements to Swich have failed ({amount} outstanding).
alertSettlementStuckOne: A settlement transfer of {amount} has been in progress for too long.
alertSettlementStuckMany: {n} settlement transfers ({amount}) have been in progress for too long.
alertCashoutReviewOne: A cashout of {amount} is waiting for manual review.
alertCashoutReviewMany: {n} cashouts ({amount}) are waiting for manual review.
alertAdviceTopUpPark: Your bank account did not have enough money for the monthly settlement. Top it up — the transfer is retried automatically every night.
alertAdviceTopUpSwich: The park's account had insufficient funds. It is retried every night; tell the park if it keeps failing.
alertAdviceSwichIban: Settlement:SwichIban is not configured on the server.
alertAdviceNoAccount: The park has no active payout account to settle from.
alertAdviceRetryTonight: It is retried automatically every night; open Settlements to retry now.
alertAdviceStuck: The bank has not confirmed the transfer. Check the bank statement before retrying.
alertAdviceReview: Nothing more is sent to the bank until someone resolves it.
alertPayoutWaitingOne: A payout of {amount} is waiting to be sent.
alertPayoutWaitingMany: {n} payouts ({amount}) are waiting to be sent.
alertAdviceWaitTopUpPark: Top up your account with at least {amount} — the waiting payouts go out automatically.
alertAdviceWaitTopUpSwich: Waiting for the park to top up its account.
alertAdviceWaitNoAccount: The park has no active payout account at the drivers' bank — once one is added in Settings, the payouts go out automatically.
alertAdviceWaitSetup: The park's bank connection needs attention (credentials or setup) — payouts resume automatically once it is fixed.
alertAdviceWaitBank: The bank is not answering — payouts resume automatically.
alertAdviceWaitOther: They are retried automatically; open Cashouts to see why or to cancel one.
alertAdviceWaitOtherPark: They are retried automatically; open Cashouts to see why.
waitReasonFunds: Waiting for the park to top up its account — it does not have enough to pay this.
waitReasonFundsPark: Your bank account does not have enough to pay this. Top it up and it goes out automatically.
waitReasonNoAccount: The park has no active payout account at the driver's bank.
waitReasonSetup: The park's bank connection needs attention (credentials or setup).
waitReasonUnresolved: The bank has not confirmed whether the last attempt went through. It is checked again with the same document, so nothing is paid twice.
waitReasonBank: The bank is not answering right now.
waitGoesOutAutomatically: The driver's Yandex balance is already debited; the payout goes out automatically as soon as the cause is gone.
cancelQueued: Cancel and return to Yandex balance
confirmCancelQueued: Cancel this payout? Nothing is sent to the bank, {amount} goes back to the driver's Yandex balance and the driver is notified.
cancelReasonPlaceholder: e.g. the driver asked to cancel; the payout was entered by mistake
cancelledOk: Payout cancelled — {amount} is back on the driver's Yandex balance.
cancelNeedsReview: Payout cancelled, but Yandex did not confirm the refund — it is now waiting for review.
cancelBlockedUnresolved: Cancel is unavailable: the bank has not said what became of a payment order already sent for this payout.
cancelOnlySwichOperator: Only Swich and the operator can cancel a waiting payout — for example, at the driver's request.
errCancelReasonRequired: Enter a reason for the cancellation.
errCancelOutcomeUnknown: Can't cancel yet: the bank has not said what became of a payment order already sent for this payout. It is checked again automatically; try again once the bank answers.
errCancelBankHasOrder: Not cancelled: the bank holds a payment order for this payout — it may already be paid. The list was refreshed to show where it stands.
errCancelBankUnconfirmed: Not cancelled: the bank could not be asked whether this payout was already sent. It keeps waiting; try again once the bank answers.
errCancelNotQueued: This payout is no longer waiting — the bank may already have it. The list was refreshed.
reconRunFound: Reconciliation finished — {n} discrepancies need a look.
errUnknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.
noParksAccessible: No parks are accessible with this login.
confirmRetryCashout: Retry this cashout? A new payout attempt will be sent to the bank.
alreadyRetried: This cashout was already retried — the new attempt is in the list.
confirmSettleNow: Settle this month now? Each park’s share is transferred from its account in proportion to its fees.
confirmDeactivateQueuedWarn: queued payout(s) on this account will stall until another account at the same bank is active.
confirmSuspendDriver: Suspend this driver? They will not be able to cash out until reactivated.
needsReconciliationHint: Bank and Yandex disagree — retry is disabled. Resolve it in Reconciliation.
swichOnly: Only Swich super-admins can register parks. Ask Swich to add the park for you.
noActivityYet: No activity yet for this park.
mcQueuedSub: The Yandex balance has been debited. The bank transfer is queued and will be retried automatically.
rejBelowMinimum: Amount is below the park minimum of
rejAboveMaximum: Amount is above the park maximum of
rejBankNotSupported: The park has no payout account at the driver's bank
rejCashoutInFlight: Another cashout for this driver is still in flight. Wait for it to finish.
rejDriverNotLinked: The driver is not linked to a Yandex profile.
rejDriverNotFound: This driver is not in the selected park.
rejDestinationNotFound: That payout account does not belong to this driver.
rejAmountPrecision: Amounts have at most two decimals (tetri).
rejDestinationRemoved: The destination account has been removed.
rejDestinationNoIban: The destination account has no IBAN.
rejBalanceUnavailable: Yandex Fleet is not answering, so the balance cannot be checked. Nothing was deducted and nothing was queued — try again later.
rejYandexReadOnly: Yandex updates are paused (read-only mode). Try again later.
rejIdempotencyConflict: This request was already used for a different cashout. Close the dialog and start again.
feeSwichOnly: Fixed by Swich — contact Swich to change it.
ibanMirrorsPrimary: Mirrors the primary payout account below.
balanceReadFailed: The bank did not return a balance
parkStatusActiveHint: Drivers can cash out. Suspending stops new cashouts at once; payouts already in the queue are still paid and the monthly settlement continues.
parkSuspendedNotice: Cashouts are paused — drivers of this park cannot withdraw.
parkSuspendedKeepsRunning: Payouts already in the queue are still paid, and the monthly settlement continues.
parkSuspendedManagerHint: Contact PayTaxi to have the park reactivated.
parkPendingNotice: Onboarding is not finished — drivers cannot cash out yet.
parkTerminatedNotice: The contract with this park has ended. Its records are kept for audit.
suspendConfirmText: New cashouts stop immediately for every driver of {park}.
reactivateConfirmText: Drivers of {park} can cash out again immediately.
suspendReasonLabel: Reason (the park manager will see it)
parkStatusInFlight: {n} payout(s) already in the queue will still be paid.
parkStatusErrReason: Enter a reason for the suspension.
parkStatusErrReasonLong: The reason is too long (500 characters max).
parkStatusErrTerminated: The contract with this park has ended; it cannot be reactivated here.
parkStatusErrForbidden: Only PayTaxi and the operator can change a park's status.
alertParkSuspended: Park suspended — drivers cannot cash out.
alertParkSuspendedOwn: Your park is suspended — drivers cannot cash out.
authGrantedHint: The park authorises the platform to pay its drivers from its account and to transfer Swich's monthly share from it (Annex 3 §2–3). It may revoke both by written notice at least 30 days ahead; what was owed before stays owed.
authRevokedInEffect: Authorisation revoked since {date} — nothing is paid or collected from the park's account
authEffectPayouts: Payouts waiting in the queue are not sent — they are cancelled in Cashouts, and the amount goes back to the driver's Yandex balance.
authEffectSettlementLicensee: Swich's share is not collected from the park's account — the licensee owes it (§2.5); its payment is recorded as paid outside the platform.
authEffectSettlementDirect: Swich's share is not collected from the park's account — the park owes it directly; its payment is recorded as paid outside the platform.
authScheduledNote: Takes effect in {n} day(s). Until then everything runs as usual, and the revocation can still be withdrawn.
authInEffectNote: It stands from that day on and can no longer be withdrawn.
authWithdrawConfirm: Withdraw the revocation? The park's authorisations stay in force.
authFromHint: At least 30 days after the notice — the earliest possible is {date}.
authReasonLabel: Reason (what the notice says, where it is filed)
authReasonPlaceholder: e.g. registered letter of 12 Oct, filed as R-17
authConfirmText: From {date} nothing will be paid or collected from {park}'s account.
authErrTooEarly: The authorisation can end no earlier than {date} — 30 days after the notice.
authErrNoticeDate: Enter the day the notice was received (not in the future).
authErrFromDate: Enter the first day without the authorisation.
authErrInPast: The first day without the authorisation can't be in the past.
authErrAlreadyRecorded: A revocation is already recorded — withdraw it first.
authErrInEffect: It has taken effect and can no longer be withdrawn.
authErrForbidden: Only Swich and the operator record or withdraw a revocation.
waitReasonRevoked: The park revoked the platform's authorisation to pay from its account (Annex 3 §7) — this payout will not be sent. Cancel it: the amount goes back to the driver's Yandex balance.
waitReasonRevokedPark: Your park revoked the platform's authorisation to pay from its account — this payout will not be sent. Swich or the operator cancels it, and the amount goes back to the driver's Yandex balance.
alertAdviceRevokedPayouts: Cancel the payouts in Cashouts — the amounts go back to the drivers' Yandex balances.
alertAdviceRevokedLicensee: The licensee owes the shares (§2.5) — record its payment as paid outside the platform.
alertAdviceRevokedPark: The park owes the shares directly — record its payment as paid outside the platform.
alertAdviceWaitRevoked: The park revoked the platform's authorisation — cancel these payouts in Cashouts.
alertAdviceWaitRevokedPark: Your park revoked the platform's authorisation — these payouts will not be sent; Swich or the operator cancels them.
stlRevokedNote: Not collected: the park revoked the platform's authorisation (Annex 3 §7). The licensee owes it (§2.5) — record its payment.
stlRevokedNoteDirect: Not collected: the park revoked the platform's authorisation (Annex 3 §7). The park owes it directly — record its payment.
stlRevokedNoteManager: Not collected from your account: your park revoked the platform's authorisation (Annex 3 §7).
stlSplitRegimes: The park changed arrangement this month: each fee is settled under the arrangement in force when it was earned — two transfers, added up here.
rejAuthorisationRevoked: The park revoked the platform's authorisation to pay from its account.
setAssignEarnedStay: Fees already earned stay under the arrangement in force when they were earned; new cashouts follow the new assignment.
setAssignUnstamped: {amount} from cashouts completed before regimes were recorded follows the new assignment.
alertSigninLockedOne: 1 driver's sign-in is locked after too many wrong codes.
alertSigninLockedMany: {n} drivers' sign-in is locked after too many wrong codes.
alertAdviceSigninLocked: Someone may be guessing a driver's sign-in code — or the driver keeps mistyping it. The lock lifts by itself within a few hours; call the driver to check it was them.
recNotePlaceholder: What happened, and what did your park do about it? Swich and the operator read this when they resolve it.
recNoteStaysOpen: A note does not resolve the discrepancy — Swich or the operator does, after reading it.
recReasonHint: The reason is required — at least {n} characters.
recReasonRequired: Give the reason — at least {n} characters.
errInvalidProvider: This server does not take that provider — choose the account's bank (TBC or BOG).
errUnsupportedBank: Payouts can only be made from a TBC or BOG account.
errTestEnvironmentNotAllowed: These credentials are for the bank's test environment, which this server does not use — enter the production credentials.
noParksOperator: No parks for this login: your licensee has no parks connected, or its licence agreement is not in force. Ask Swich if this is unexpected.
